prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a hand holding a modern smartphone, with the screen prominently displaying a glowing circular charging indicator at 100%. The phone is angled slightly, filling most of the frame, with the illuminated ring and bold white "100%" text sharply in focus at the center. The background is softly blurred, featuring hints of blue fabric and neutral tones, suggesting a casual indoor setting. Natural daylight streams in from the side, casting gentle highlights on the hand and phone, while the overall color palette is cool and subdued, with the bright cyan glow of the charging ring providing a striking contrast. The composition emphasizes the sense of completion and technological efficiency, with a shallow depth of field and a crisp, modern aesthetic.
